records.match: transition: background-color var(--ds-motion-tap), border-color var(--ds-motion-tap), color var(--ds-motion-tap)
records.rationale: --ds-motion-tap is a combined duration+easing token (120ms ease-out), not a bare duration -- it cannot be split into transition-property/transition-duration/transition-timing-function longhand, since transition-duration only accepts a time value and would reject the combined string. The multi-property transition list itself has no single-token equivalent in the generated token set.
records.reviewCondition: a combined multi-property transition-list token, or a duration-only motion token, is added to the design system

records.rationale: Same reasoning as iconbutton-transition-motion-tap -- --ds-motion-tap is a combined duration+easing token that cannot be split into transition longhand without becoming invalid CSS, and no single-token equivalent for a multi-property transition list exists.
